annotation.title_clean: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.title_en: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital / National AI Office (NAIO), Malaysia
annotation.venue: Unified Public Consultation (UPC) platform, MPC Malaysia
annotation.summary_en: Malaysian UPC portal page for the closed public consultation (10 Jul–1 Aug 2026) on the National AI Office's proposed AI Governance Bill, with stakeholder comments. The Bill proposes a Central AI Authority, Sectoral Leads, five principles, three-tier risk framework, incident reporting and a sandbox. Comments urge broader harm definitions, liability allocation, and redress.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposed Bill establishes a Central AI Authority with Sectoral Leads
Five-principle baseline and three-tier risk-based framework
Developer/Deployer roles allocated by degree of control
Incident reporting mechanism and AI Sandbox proposed
Submitters call for wider harm taxonomy, liability allocation, appeal rights and independent oversight
